app.name: VieWallet
app.simulationNotice: Simulation environment — no real money, no real banks.

home.title: Welcome to VieWallet
home.intro: Create a simulated account to get started. Wallet, deposits and transfers arrive in the next phases.
home.signedInIntro: Your balance and recent transactions are below. Deposits, withdrawals and transfers arrive in later phases.

status.errorDescription: Check that the backend is running, then try again.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tryLater: Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.pinResetRequired: The PIN was locked several times. Reset it with your password and an e-mail code.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A memorable phrase works well; do not use your e-mail or name.
fields.passwordWeak: Password is not strong enough: at least 10 characters, not a common one, and not containing your e-mail or name.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to manage your simulated wallet.
login.notVerified: Your e-mail is not verified yet.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: It takes a minute. We will e-mail you a verification code.
register.simulationBody: No real money is involved. Use fictional details, never real personal data.

verify.title: Verify your e-mail
verify.description: Enter the 6-digit code we just sent you.
verify.codeHint: The code is valid for 15 minutes.
verify.resent: If the address is valid, a new code was sent.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your e-mail and we will send a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If the address has an account, a reset link (valid for 30 minutes) was sent.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: After the change every signed-in device is signed out.
reset.done: Password changed. Please sign in again.
reset.missingToken: Invalid link. Open the exact link from the e-mail.

pin.title: Transaction PIN
pin.rules: A 6-digit PIN confirms every payment out of your wallet. Avoid easy sequences like 123456 or 111111. Five wrong tries lock it for 30 minutes.

setup.title: Set your transaction PIN
setup.description: Last step before using the wallet.

pin.missingTitle: You have not set a transaction PIN yet.
pin.sendResetCode: E-mail me a PIN reset code
pin.codeSent: A PIN reset code was sent to your e-mail.

security.title: Account security
security.description: Manage your password, transaction PIN and signed-in devices.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing the password signs out every other device.

wallet.title: My wallet
wallet.description: Other VieWallet users send money to your wallet number.
wallet.frozenSelf: You froze this wallet. All transactions are paused; unfreeze it with your transaction PIN.
wallet.frozenStaff: Support has frozen this wallet. Please contact support to unfreeze it.
wallet.freezeBody: Use this if you lost your phone or suspect someone else is using your wallet. A frozen wallet cannot send or receive money. You can unfreeze it with your PIN.
wallet.unfreezeBody: Enter your transaction PIN to unfreeze.
wallet.comingSoon: Deposits, withdrawals and transfers arrive in later phases.

history.title: Transaction history
history.description: Every transaction of your wallet, newest first.
history.emptyBody: Your transactions will show up here.

txn.notFoundBody: It does not exist or does not belong to your wallet.
